name: kanban store
description:
# Summary

I analyzed the kanban component structure and created a new Pinia-based `kanban.js` store to centralize all kanban operations that were previously scattered across components and the project service. The store manages project-scoped kanban state including boards, columns, hierarchy, and bookmarks with actions for CRUD operations. I also updated the `project.js` service with integration methods to load/save kanban and created a `useProjectKanban` composable for easy component access to kanban functionality. This architecture ensures all kanban logic is project-scoped and reusable across components through clean, reactive APIs.
